fix: [v1.17.9] resolve bootstrap deadlock — agent runs end-to-end (checkpoint 36)

The merged runtime hung during instance bootstrap (the `run` command booted through
db-migrations then deadlocked before the agent loop; bootstrap-heavy tests hung too).
Typecheck-green had masked it — only real execution surfaced it. Root-caused to TWO
stacked issues + several follow-on runtime gaps, all now fixed and VERIFIED:

1. `Project.fromDirectory -> ProjectID.make()` INFINITE SELF-RECURSION: `withStatics()`
   (core/schema.ts) passed the mutable schema into statics then assigned `make` over
   `schema.make`, so `.make()` called itself forever. Fixed: give statics a stable
   pre-augmented schema.
2. RE-ENTRANT runtime build: `Plugin.init -> Config.get()` built the `@opencode/Config`
   per-module makeRuntime while running under the legacy instance ALS but OUTSIDE an
   Effect fiber, losing instance context. Fixed: preserve/restore instance context for
   the legacy Promise facades during Effect bootstrap (run-service.ts, plugin/index.ts,
   project/bootstrap.ts).

Follow-on fixes uncovered by driving the run to completion:
- storage/db.ts: initialize/repair the fork SQLite schema so fresh + legacy DBs work
  after bootstrap reaches real work (initializeFreshDatabase + skip migrate on fresh).
- config/config.ts + config/paths.ts: BRANDING REGRESSION — were importing upstream
  `@opencode-ai/core/global` (~/.config/opencode); restored fork `../global`
  (~/.config/altimate-code) so fork config (incl. provider creds) loads correctly.
- util/effect-zod.ts: tuple + StructWithRest conversion for route/config-plugin schemas.
- session/summary.ts + session/status.ts: keep post-turn legacy session summary/status
  on the legacy DB/Bus path so `run` exits cleanly on idle.
- tool/truncation.ts: skip malformed legacy tool_* files during cleanup.

VERIFIED (independently re-run, not just codex's claim):
- bun test instance-bootstrap + cli/run/runtime.boot + id: 21 pass, 3 skip, 0 fail (4.3s, no hang).
- typecheck: 0 errors.
- real run repro (azure/gpt-4o-mini): `> builder · gpt-4o-mini` -> "WORKING", exit 0.

Diagnosis via codex (separate quota); all edits reviewed + independently verified here.
Diagnostic instrumentation fully removed. db.ts +199 (fresh-db schema) flagged for a
deeper correctness review (schema parity vs full migrations) in follow-up.
